The HALT Fentanyl Act is an important step in tackling this deadly crisis. 

WATCH coverage of yesterday's vote from @KESQ: https://t.co/nZdYNvdX0D
The United States must send an unequivocal message to China and Iran that America and our allies will fully exercise and defend our rights in international waters anywhere in the world.

Three years ago today, First Lt. David Schmitz (callsign “MEZr”) was tragically killed during a training exercise when his ejection seat malfunctioned during a nighttime landing. Lt. Schmitz and his wife lived in Riverside County and were my constituents. https://t.co/XKSgXYUDsT

Under Biden’s Justice Department, the President’s political enemies are being indicted with unprecedented charges, while his family members are receiving unprecedented sweetheart plea deals and special treatment.

Patients diagnosed with aggressive cancer need support immediately. That's why I cosponsored H.R. 549 to waive the 5-month waiting period for Social Security Disability Insurance  and the 24-month waiting period for Medicare benefits for individuals with metastatic breast cancer. https://t.co/Ax9cqAzRB8

I’m thrilled that so many Coachella Valley seniors were able to get assistance at my office’s Senior Resource Fair today. Thanks to all of our resource providers, presenters, the @CityofLaQuinta and the Wellness Center for hosting. https://t.co/YONa6sW0ZE

Where is the international demand to ensure Hamas lets civilians evacuate? 

Where are the protests on college campuses demanding the release of hostages? 

Where are calls among the progressive left for Hamas to stop firing rockets and hiding in hospitals?

We can’t keep dumping billions of tax dollars into the same homeless programs and hope for different results. Read my op-ed about the bill I introduced this week to get those living on the streets with mental health or drug abuse challenges the treatment they need.
Early cancer detection is critical. As a cosponsor of this bill, I'm happy to see this bipartisan legislation advance to expand Medicare coverage of multi-cancer early detection screening tests.

Since his ALS diagnosis in 2011, @SteveGleason has been an inspiration to those impacted by ALS and beyond. Those of us in the House ALS Caucus can attest to the incredible power of his advocacy. Honoring Steve with the Arthur Ashe Courage Award is truly fitting.

Our veterans deserve the best treatment possible when utilizing the benefits they earned by serving our country. The passage of the Stuck on Hold Act is just one step in our ongoing attempt to honor our commitment to America's veterans. https://t.co/4TppeiSL6B

Earlier today I toured the @CityofHope cancer treatment center in Corona. I was proud to secure $700,000 in federal funding for new equipment to expand outpatient care here in Corona for cancer patients throughout the region. Thankful for the extraordinary care they provide.

When children suffer from medically complex conditions, like cancer or other rare diseases, they often need to access specialized providers found in children’s hospitals out-of-state. I recently joined my House colleagues in passing the bipartisan Accelerating Kids' Access to Care Act to streamline the burdensome and time-consuming Medicaid provider screening and enrollment process when necessary out-of-state care is needed.

Many homeless individuals are suffering from drug abuse and/or mental health issues, and require more help than housing. I just introduced the Treatment and Homelessness Housing Integration Act to address this problem by synchronizing housing programs together with behavioral health services. 

Read more ➡️ https://t.co/e8BRBYKFtl

Homeless individuals suffering from mental health issues or drug abuse need more assistance than just help with housing. That's why I've introduced legislation aimed at better synchronizing federal housing aid with mental health and drug abuse treatment. https://t.co/uBpvNAeiPO

I am proud to cosponsor H.R. 842, the Nancy Gardner Sewell Medicare Multi-Cancer Early Detection Screening Coverage Act, to grant Medicare the authority to cover multi-cancer early detection tests which have the potential to detect multiple cancers in a single test.

Like President Trump makes clear in this interview, Republicans are protecting Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid for Americans who rely upon these important programs. Anyone suggesting otherwise is simply not telling the truth.

This is just one example of the billions of dollars in waste, fraud and abuse that we must cut from Medicaid to protect taxpayers and ensure the program has the resources necessary for the Americans who rely upon the healthcare it provides.

California taxpayers are being forced to pay billions to provide free healthcare for illegal immigrants because of the radical policies of Democrats in Sacramento. No other state in the country provides free healthcare to all illegal immigrants. This policy is unsustainable.

Anyone battling metastatic breast cancer knows that every minute is precious. I have cosponsored H.R. 2048, a bipartisan bill to eliminate waiting periods for Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) benefits and Medicare coverage for those with metastatic breast cancer.

Even the liberal NY Times admits House Democrats are exaggerating about the Medicaid impacts of the House GOP reconciliation bill. 

The truth? We are strengthening Medicaid for children, mothers, people with disabilities and the elderly—for whom the program was designed. https://t.co/jjmaXBaJIJ
The same Democrats in Congress who lied to Americans about President Biden's condition are now lying to Americans about changes to Medicaid.

My office and I are monitoring the news of a large explosion at the American Reproductive Centers IVF treatment facility in Palm Springs this afternoon. As we await more information, please adhere to all instructions from local law enforcement.

In the aftermath of Saturday's bombing, Palm Springs Deputy Fire Chief Greg Lyle and FBI agent Chris Meltzer rushed to save embryos & other materials that were critical for the IVF facility's patients. Their heroism will make life possible. Thank you both! https://t.co/urUbpEDei3

I've made it one of top priorities to protect American families and small business from what would be the largest tax increase in history if Congress fails to act. Radical Democrats might be willing to increase taxes to keep illegal immigrants on Medicaid but I am not.
